thread:
incidents-bot: High error rate alert for rl-service in eu-west — 429s + 5xx jump ~48% vs baseline. Alert: PG-ALERT-rl-429. Paging on-call.

emma: ack — i'm oncall and joining. opening investigation thread.

emma: quick glance at grafana shows concentrated spikes originating from rl-canary pods in eu-west. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rl/rl-service?from=now-15m

raj: rolled rl-ratecap v2 canary at ~09:10 UTC. change set included new exemptions key format and stricter enforcement semantics. I thought migration for exemptions was part of preflight but maybe not on all nodes.

marta: any reports from customers? @customer_success_anna @dan please check high-touch accounts.

dan: FintechCo and HealthFlow reported increased 429s starting ~09:16. They're seeing mid-request throttles on streaming calls. They've throttled down heavy jobs.

emma: pulling canary logs now:
```
2026-03-15T09:17:56Z rl-ratecap[rl-canary-1]: WARN exemptions.lookup miss account=acct-3345
2026-03-15T09:17:56Z rl-ratecap[rl-canary-1]: ERROR enforcement.denied account=acct-3345 code=RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
```
Looks like exemptions table empty/missing on some canaries, causing enforced limits for accounts that should be exempt.

raj: confirmed: the rollout included a migration that renames exemption keys. the migration hook didn't run successfully on two canary pods due to short DB timeouts. toggles started enforcing against old keyspace.

emma: i'm going to flip the enforcement flag off and request a rollback for the canary roll. we need to stop customer impact asap.

feature-flags-bot: Flag update: rlv2_enable_enforce set to false (updated by emma)

deploy-bot: Rollout undo initiated: `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/rl-ratecap --to-revision=previous`. Rolling back canary cohort in eu-west. job id: rl-undo-412

raj: starting targeted migration dry-run on canaries: `./scripts/exemptions_migrate.sh --env=canary --dry-run`

raj: dry-run shows 3/5 canaries had old keyspace present; 2 canaries failed to contact the DB replica (timeout). switching to rollback and will investigate DB replica health.

deploy-bot: Rollout undo completed. canary pods reverted to previous image. healthchecks: passing.

incidents-bot: Metrics update: 429/5xx rates back to baseline within ~4 minutes post-rollback.

emma: verifying exempted accounts now pass. sample from prod after rollback:
```
2026-03-15T09:22:58Z rl-ratecap[rl-prod-3]: INFO exemptions.hit account=acct-3345 reason=svc-exempt
2026-03-15T09:22:58Z rl-ratecap[rl-prod-3]: INFO request.allowed account=acct-3345
```

emma: noticing token-accountant discrepancies: a small set (~8) accounts show processed_tokens != billed_tokens after the canary window. looks like some streaming aborts didn't report final counts.

jackson: taking on-call handoff from emma for the next 2 hours. emma please hand over context and runbook.

emma: handing off dashboard links, logs, and rollback transcript. owners noted in incident ticket. ping me if we need escalation.

raj: additional finding: the token-accountant sidecar was bumped in the same release (minor image change). its shutdown/stream-finalize path has a race where aborted streams don't flush counters back to the aggregator. combined with transient DB errors during migration, some accounting messages were dropped.

raj: quick mitigation — revert token-accountant sidecar image to previous tag on affected clusters. initiating canary sidecar rollback.

deploy-bot: sidecar rollback job started: token-sidecar-rollback-89

emma: drafted customer-facing note for CS — please review:
"Hi — we rolled out a rate-limit change to a small canary cohort which briefly enforced a new exemptions schema before migrations completed. This caused transient throttling for some customers; we rolled back the canary and disabled the enforcement flag. We're investigating a token-counting discrepancy for a small number of accounts and will follow up if there is any billing impact. No action required on your part. — Redwood Support"

customer_success_anna: LGTM. Sending to FintechCo and HealthFlow now and monitoring responses.

dan: FintechCo reported recovery. They asked for a postmortem and confirmation there won't be unexpected billing.

marta: action items and owners:
- raj: make migration a blocking preflight step for schema changes + add circuit-breaker that prevents enforcement switch until migration success is verified.
- raj + eng-db: create migration playbook with retries/backoff and health prechecks for replicas.
- eng-runtime (emma): ensure sidecar image upgrades are decoupled from enforcement rollout in CI and add canary gating.
- cs (customer_success_anna): follow up with impacted accounts if accounting reconciliation shows billing differences.

jackson: scheduling a controlled migration window during lower DB load (target 12:30 UTC) with extended timeouts and preflight checks. will run against a staging replica first.

raj: will implement CI gate: if migration preflight fails, rollout will abort automatically.

marta: creating an incident record and assigning postmortem. include timeline, root cause, and the owners listed above. ensure blameless tone.

emma: closing active mitigations: rollback, flag disable, sidecar revert in progress. token-accounting reconciliation ongoing for 8 accounts; we'll update CS by EOD.

marta: thanks all. keep updates in the incident ticket and the migration playbook PR. we'll add automated tests to guard schema-dependent feature flags going forward. :white_check_mark:
